composition_subtypes.role: Sliding window to find max photos in time T within O(n) amortized time

payload.core_composition_summary: Uses a two-pointer sliding window over the circular photo sequence to find the maximum number of photos viewable within time T, achieving amortized O(n) complexity.
payload.rationale: The code solely relies on a sliding window/two-pointer technique; no DP, sorting, or complete search is employed.
